# SEARCH
# third_party/bigquery_docs/reference/standard-sql/search_functions.md

# What a backtick term matches with PATTERN_ANALYZER: a substring anywhere, one between
# matches of the pattern, or one at word boundaries, and with which case.

SELECT SEARCH('foobar', '`oob`', analyzer => 'PATTERN_ANALYZER')
?>

SELECT SEARCH('xfoo bar', '`foo`', analyzer => 'PATTERN_ANALYZER')
?>

SELECT SEARCH('foo-bar', '`o-b`', analyzer => 'PATTERN_ANALYZER')
?>

SELECT SEARCH('foo bar', '`Foo`', analyzer => 'PATTERN_ANALYZER')
?>

SELECT SEARCH('foo bar', '`foo  bar`', analyzer => 'PATTERN_ANALYZER')
?>

SELECT SEARCH('ab12cd', '`12`', analyzer => 'PATTERN_ANALYZER', analyzer_options => '{"patterns": ["[a-z]+"]}')
?>

# OR with a term without search tokens, when no other term matches: whether the term is left
# out or matches.

SELECT SEARCH('foo', 'bar OR ...')
?>

SELECT SEARCH('foo', '(bar ...) OR (... ...)')
?>

# Whitespace the grammar's errors do not settle: around parentheses, after the query and twice
# around AND.

SELECT SEARCH('foo', 'foo ')
?>

SELECT SEARCH('foo', ' foo')
?>

SELECT SEARCH('foo', '( foo )')
?>

SELECT SEARCH('foo bar', 'foo  AND  bar')
?>

SELECT SEARCH('foo bar', 'foo AND(bar)')
?>

SELECT SEARCH('foo bar', '(foo)AND bar')
?>

SELECT SEARCH('foo bar', 'foo AND ')
?>

SELECT SEARCH('foo', 'foo OR ')
?>

# Positions after multibyte characters, and the text of a recognition error after one.

SELECT SEARCH('é', 'é-')
?>

SELECT SEARCH('é', 'éé)')
?>

# Escaped characters that are also delimiters, in a phrase and at a term's end.

SELECT SEARCH('foo bar', 'foo\\(')
?>

SELECT SEARCH('foo', 'foo\\"')
?>

SELECT SEARCH('a"b', '`a"b`')
?>

SELECT SEARCH('a`b', R'`a\`b`')
?>

# Whether a collation changes what SEARCH matches.

SELECT SEARCH(COLLATE('Foo', 'und:ci'), '`foo`')
?>

SELECT SEARCH(COLLATE('Foo', 'und:ci'), 'foo', analyzer => 'NO_OP_ANALYZER')
?>

SELECT SEARCH(COLLATE('Foo', 'und:ci'), 'foo', analyzer_options => '{"token_filters": [{"normalizer": {"mode": "NONE"}}]}')
?>

# Pattern errors, which BigQuery's TEXT_ANALYZE follows with the function's name.

SELECT SEARCH('foo', 'foo', analyzer => 'PATTERN_ANALYZER', analyzer_options => '{"patterns": ["("]}')
?>

SELECT SEARCH('foo', 'foo', analyzer => 'PATTERN_ANALYZER', analyzer_options => '{"patterns": ["(a)"]}')
?>

# A search_query that is constant but neither a literal nor a parameter, and errors that depend
# on the data, such as for an empty table.

SELECT SEARCH('foo', CONCAT('f', 'oo'), analyzer => CONCAT('LOG', '_ANALYZER'))
?>

SELECT SEARCH(s, '') FROM UNNEST(CAST([] AS ARRAY<STRING>)) AS s
?>

SELECT SEARCH(s, 'foo-') FROM UNNEST(CAST([] AS ARRAY<STRING>)) AS s
?>
